interactions.teaches: Public trials make evidence and defense part of lawful punishment.
interactions.studentAction: Choose trial or immediate execution, then defend a trade-off.
interactions.feedback: Immediate historical and ethical consequences appear for each choice.
interactions.staticFallback: Both options and trade-offs are written in the page.
interactions.identityFit: Two competing docket dispositions; neither offers arcade points.

interactions.teaches: Death sentences are not the same number as completed executions.
interactions.studentAction: Reveal Göring and Bormann's separate outcomes.
interactions.feedback: Two historical explanations fill the gap between twelve and ten.
interactions.staticFallback: Full explanation available in the narrative.

interactions.teaches: A reported quotation is not proof of the factual claim quoted.
interactions.studentAction: Switch between the 347-execution claim and archival estimate.
interactions.feedback: Claims and historians' findings appear in contrasted evidence fields.
interactions.staticFallback: Both numbers are explained in narrative text.

interactions.teaches: Direct observation differs from inference about what was hidden.
interactions.studentAction: Identify the claim a witness could not directly establish.
interactions.feedback: Explains why seeing or hearing does not determine intent or duration.
interactions.staticFallback: Witness limits are described immediately above the control.

interactions.teaches: Historical claims must be classified as verified, attributed, or not established.
interactions.studentAction: Categorize six dated claims and read source-specific feedback.
interactions.feedback: Correctness and contextual source note appear for each claim.
interactions.staticFallback: Definitions and surrounding narrative convey the distinctions.

interactions.teaches: Separate likely mishandling from independently proving intention.
interactions.studentAction: Choose a cautious conclusion and write a two-source argument and ethical reflection.
interactions.feedback: Student answers persist via shared Turn In and may be copied as a backup.
interactions.staticFallback: All questions are ordinary labeled form fields.
